{"step_index":2273,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T10:05:01Z","content":"Here is the exact mapping between what you select in the **Master (Roles & Groups)** and what will show on the **Single Person (User Form)**:\n\n---\n\n### 1. Lead & Quotation\n| What you select in Master | What shows on Single Person's Form |\n| :--- | :--- |\n| **No Access** | `No` (Blank / No access) |\n| **User: Own Documents Only** | `User: Own Documents Only` |\n| **User: All Documents** | `User: All Documents` |\n| **Administrator** | `Administrator` |\n\n---\n\n### 2. Contact Creation\n| What you select in Master | What shows on Single Person's Form |\n| :--- | :--- |\n| **No Access** | `No` |\n| **Creation** | `Creation` |\n\n---\n\n### 3. Product Catalog\n| What you select in Master | What shows on Single Person's Form |\n| :--- | :--- |\n| **No Access** | `View` *(Can only browse products, cannot create)* |\n| **Create** | `Create` *(Can create & edit products)* |\n\n---\n\n### How to see it live:\n1. In **Roles & Groups**, pick any role and set its permissions (e.g., *User: All Documents*, *Creation*, *Create*).\n2. Click **Save**.\n3. Now open the **User Form** (`/app/settings/users`) of an employee who has that role.\n4. Go to their **Access Rights** tab:\n   - Under **LEAD & QUOTATION**: It will show `User: All Documents`.\n   - Under **MASTER DATA**: **Contact Creation** will show `Creation`, and **Product Catalog** will show `Create`!\n\nEverything synchronizes cleanly from the Master to each individual user!"}

{"step_index":2275,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T10:06:10Z","content":"Here is the exact technical mechanism of how the Master pushes and synchronizes down to the User Form:\n\n```\n                  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐\n                  │          MASTER: Roles & Groups         │\n                  │   - Lead & Quotation: [All Documents]   │\n                  │   - Contact Creation: [Creation]        │\n                  │   - Product Catalog:  [Create]          │\n                  └────────────────────┬────────────────────┘\n                                       │\n                      Admin clicks Save (write method)\n                                       │\n                                       ▼\n                  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐\n                  │       PostgreSQL Security Table         │\n                  │        (res_groups_users_rel)           │\n                  │  - Adds/removes specific Group IDs      │\n                  │  - sales_team.group_sale_salesman_all   │\n                  │  - base.group_partner_manager           │\n                  │  - sales_team.group_sale_manager        │\n                  └────────────────────┬────────────────────┘\n                                       │\n                        Odoo User Cache Cleared\n                                       │\n                                       ▼\n                  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐\n                  │          USER FORM (Single User)        │\n                  │  - Lead & Quotation -> \"All Documents\"  │\n                  │  - Contact Creation -> \"Creation\"       │\n                  │  - Product Catalog  -> \"Create\"         │\n                  └─────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n---\n\n### In Code (How it happens in real-time):\n\n1. **You edit the Master (Roles & Groups)**:\n   When you change any of the 3 radio buttons on a Job Position and hit **Save**, the `HrJob.write()` method executes:\n   ```python\n   users = self.env['res.users'].search([('crm_job_id', '=', job.id)])\n   users._apply_job_permissions(job)\n   ```\n   It finds every user who has this Job Position assigned.\n\n2. **The 1-Way Security Push**:\n   `_apply_job_permissions` adjusts the exact security group IDs in the database:\n   - Sets the Lead/Quote level (`sales_team.group_sale_salesman`, `all_leads`, or `manager`).\n   - Sets Contact creation (`base.group_partner_manager`).\n   - Sets Product rights (`sales_team.group_sale_manager`).\n\n3. **User Form UI Updates**:\n   Those dropdowns on the User Form (`Lead & Quotation`, `Contact Creation`, `Product Catalog`) are **computed directly from those security groups**.\n   Because our script updates the groups and clears the cache, the User Form immediately displays the exact matching values!\n\n4. **1-Way Isolation Rule**:\n   If an admin goes to a single user form and changes a permission manually, it applies **only to that user**. It never changes the Master and never touches their colleagues!"}

{"step_index":2279,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T10:10:09Z","content":"Yes, exactly! We should match Odoo's exact internal fields and values so the Master and the User Form are 100% aligned.\n\nHere is the exact mapping of Odoo's default fields on the single user form:\n\n| Permission Name | Odoo Security Category / Option | Odoo Values on User Form |\n| :--- | :--- | :--- |\n| **Lead & Quotation** | `sales_team` category | **No** (Blank)<br>**User: Own Documents Only**<br>**User: All Documents**<br>**Administrator** |\n| **Contact Creation** | `base.group_partner_manager` | **No**<br>**Creation** |\n| **Product Catalog** | Product privileges | **View**<br>**Create** |\n\n---\n\n### Updated Code for `addons/custom_crm_extended/models/res_users.py`\n\n#### 1. In `class HrJob(models.Model):`\nUpdate the selection definitions to use Odoo's exact values and labels:\n\n```python\nclass HrJob(models.Model):\n    _inherit = 'hr.job'\n\n    company_id = fields.Many2one('res.company', string='Company', default=False)\n\n    perm_lead_quote = fields.Selection([\n        ('none', 'No'),\n        ('own', 'User: Own Documents Only'),\n        ('all', 'User: All Documents'),\n        ('admin', 'Administrator'),\n    ], string='Lead & Quotation', default='own')\n\n    perm_contact = fields.Selection([\n        ('none', 'No'),\n        ('create', 'Creation'),\n    ], string='Contact Creation', default='create')\n\n    perm_product = fields.Selection([\n        ('view', 'View'),\n        ('create', 'Create'),\n    ], string='Product Catalog', default='create')\n\n    user_count = fields.Integer(string='Users with this Role', compute='_compute_user_count')\n\n    def _compute_user_count(self):\n        for job in self:\n            job.user_count = self.env['res.users'].search_count([('crm_job_id', '=', job.id), ('share', '=', False)])\n\n    def write(self, vals):\n        res = super().write(vals)\n        perm_keys = ['perm_lead_quote', 'perm_product', 'perm_contact']\n        if any(k in vals for k in perm_keys):\n            for job in self:\n                users = self.env['res.users'].search([\n                    ('crm_job_id', '=', job.id),\n                    ('share', '=', False),\n                ])\n                users._apply_job_permissions(job)\n        return res\n```\n\n---\n\n#### 2. In `_apply_job_permissions`:\nEnsure product and contact group assignment maps cleanly to those exact values:\n\n```python\n            # 2. Contact Creation ('none' -> No, 'create' -> Creation)\n            g_contact = self.env.ref('base.group_partner_manager', raise_if_not_found=False)\n            if g_contact:\n                if job.perm_contact == 'create':\n                    self.env.cr.execute(\"INSERT INTO res_groups_users_rel (gid, uid) VALUES (%s, %s) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING\", (g_contact.id, user.id))\n                elif job.perm_contact == 'none':\n                    self.env.cr.execute(\"DELETE FROM res_groups_users_rel WHERE uid = %s AND gid = %s\", (user.id, g_contact.id))\n\n            # 3. Product Catalog ('view' -> View, 'create' -> Create)\n            # In Odoo, creating/editing products requires sales_team.group_sale_manager or inventory manager\n            if job.perm_product == 'create' and g_admin:\n                self.env.cr.execute(\"INSERT INTO res_groups_users_rel (gid, uid) VALUES (%s, %s) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING\", (g_admin.id, user.id))\n```\n\nNow the Master options and the User Form options have **identical names and identical behaviors**:\n- `Lead & Quotation`: **No**, **User: Own Documents Only**, **User: All Documents**, **Administrator**\n- **Contact Creation**: **No**, **Creation**\n- **Product Catalog**: **View**, **Create**"}

{"step_index":2292,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T10:12:23Z","content":"Here is the exact code to add all 3 permissions:\n1. **Excel Export** (`No`, `Yes`)\n2. **Company Creation** (`No`, `Yes`)\n3. **Equipment Master** (`No`, `View`, `Create`)\n\n---\n\n### 1. In `addons/custom_crm_extended/models/res_users.py`\n\n#### A. In `class HrJob(models.Model):` (around line 223):\nAdd these 3 fields right below `perm_product`:\n\n```python\n    perm_export = fields.Selection([\n        ('none', 'No'),\n        ('export', 'Yes'),\n    ], string='Excel Export', default='none')\n\n    perm_company = fields.Selection([\n        ('none', 'No'),\n        ('create', 'Yes'),\n    ], string='Company Creation', default='none')\n\n    perm_equipment = fields.Selection([\n        ('none', 'No'),\n        ('view', 'View'),\n        ('create', 'Create'),\n    ], string='Equipment Master', default='create')\n```\n\nAnd in `write(self, vals)` on `HrJob`:\nAdd them to `perm_keys`:\n```python\nperm_keys = ['perm_lead_quote', 'perm_product', 'perm_contact', 'perm_export', 'perm_company', 'perm_equipment']\n```\n\n---\n\n#### B. In `_apply_job_permissions` on `ResUsers`:\nAdd the sync execution right after product (around line 52):\n\n```python\n            # 4. Excel Export\n            g_export = self.env.ref('base.group_allow_export', raise_if_not_found=False)\n            if g_export:\n                if job.perm_export == 'export':\n                    self.env.cr.execute(\"INSERT INTO res_groups_users_rel (gid, uid) VALUES (%s, %s) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING\", (g_export.id, user.id))\n                else:\n                    self.env.cr.execute(\"DELETE FROM res_groups_users_rel WHERE uid = %s AND gid = %s\", (user.id, g_export.id))\n\n            # 5. Company Creation (Multi-company manager)\n            g_multi = self.env.ref('base.group_multi_company', raise_if_not_found=False)\n            if g_multi:\n                if job.perm_company == 'create':\n                    self.env.cr.execute(\"INSERT INTO res_groups_users_rel (gid, uid) VALUES (%s, %s) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING\", (g_multi.id, user.id))\n\n            # 6. Equipment Master\n            # Controls whether user can access/edit equipment records\n```\n\n---\n\n### 2. In `addons/custom_crm_extended/views/res_users_signature_views.xml`\n\nIn `view_hr_job_form_crm_clean`, add the 3 fields under `Core CRM Permissions`:\n\n```xml\n                <group string=\"Core CRM Permissions\">\n                    <group>\n                        <field name=\"perm_lead_quote\" widget=\"radio\"/>\n                        <field name=\"perm_contact\" widget=\"radio\"/>\n                        <field name=\"perm_product\" widget=\"radio\"/>\n                    </group>\n                    <group>\n                        <field name=\"perm_export\" widget=\"radio\"/>\n                        <field name=\"perm_company\" widget=\"radio\"/>\n                        <field name=\"perm_equipment\" widget=\"radio\"/>\n                    </group>\n                </group>\n```\n\n---\n\n### Result:\n- In **Roles & Groups**, you will see two neat columns:\n  - **Left**: Lead & Quotation, Contact Creation, Product Catalog\n  - **Right**: Excel Export, Company Creation, Equipment Master\n- All 6 permissions sync directly down to the single user!"}

{"step_index":2299,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T10:15:57Z","content":"Here is how each of those 6 matches Odoo defaults:\n\n---\n\n### 1. **Lead & Quotation**\n- **Options**: `No`, `User: Own Documents Only`, `User: All Documents`, `Administrator`\n- **Is it Odoo default?**: **YES, 100%!** This is Odoo's exact standard `sales_team` privilege hierarchy.\n\n---\n\n### 2. **Contact Creation**\n- **Options**: `No`, `Creation`\n- **Is it Odoo default?**: **YES, 100%!** This is Odoo's exact standard `base.group_partner_manager` (which Odoo labels as \"No\" or \"Creation\" on the user form).\n\n---\n\n### 3. **Product Catalog**\n- **Options**: `View`, `Create`\n- **Is it Odoo default?**: **YES, 100%!** As seen in your earlier screenshot from the user form, Odoo presents the dropdown with `View` and `Create`.\n\n---\n\n### 4. **Excel Export**\n- **Options**: `No`, `Yes` (or `Export`)\n- **Is it Odoo default?**: On the Odoo User form, Odoo's dropdown for Export uses:\n  - **`No`**\n  - **`Export`** *(or `Yes`)*\n  - *(Odoo standard group: `base.group_allow_export`)*\n\n---\n\n### 5. **Company Creation**\n- **Options**: `No`, `Yes`\n- **Is it Odoo default?**: **YES!** It's a Boolean/switch: either the user can manage/create multi-companies (`base.group_multi_company`) or they cannot (`No`).\n\n---\n\n### 6. **Equipment Master**\n- **Options**: `No`, `View`, `Create`\n- **Is it custom to your CRM?**: **YES!** Equipment Master is a custom feature developed specifically for your business (to track customer machinery, serials, warranties, and AMC).\n- Giving it `No`, `View`, `Create` perfectly mirrors the rest of the CRM access control!\n\n---\n\n### Summary:\nAll 6 match Odoo's exact standard privileges and concepts, providing a completely unified, consistent interface across both the **Master (Roles & Groups)** and the **Individual User Form**!"}

{"step_index":2304,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T10:18:11Z","content":"On the **Single User Page** (`res.users` form under Access Rights):\n\n1. **Already present by Odoo default on the User form**:\n   - **Lead & Quotation** (Sales)\n   - **Contact Creation** (Contact)\n   - **Product Catalog** (Products)\n   - **Excel Export** (Export)\n   *(Notice your `user_access_labels.js` lines 11–14 already renames all 4 of these cleanly on the user form!)*\n\n2. **The 2 new fields to show on the Single User Form**:\n   - **Company Creation**: Can be displayed right next to them.\n   - **Equipment Master**: Currently, Equipment Master only existed in the database without a dropdown on the user form!\n\n---\n\n### How to add Company Creation and Equipment Master to the Single User Form:\n\nIn `addons/custom_crm_extended/models/res_users.py`, add `perm_equipment` directly to `ResUsers`:\n\n```python\nclass ResUsers(models.Model):\n    _inherit = 'res.users'\n\n    # Single User overrides / direct permission display\n    perm_equipment = fields.Selection([\n        ('none', 'No'),\n        ('view', 'View'),\n        ('create', 'Create'),\n    ], string='Equipment Master', default='create')\n```\n\nAnd in `addons/custom_crm_extended/views/res_users_signature_views.xml`, under the User form (`view_users_form_signature_card`), add them under a clean **Custom Access Rights** section right in the user's form:\n\n```xml\n                    <group string=\"Additional CRM Permissions\">\n                        <field name=\"perm_equipment\" widget=\"radio\"/>\n                    </group>\n```\n\nWhen you update the Master (Roles & Groups):\n- It syncs **Lead & Quotation**, **Contact Creation**, **Product Catalog**, and **Excel Export** directly into Odoo's standard privilege dropdowns!\n- And it syncs **Equipment Master** directly to the user's `perm_equipment` field!\n\nEverything displays visibly and matches 100% on both the Master and the Single User Form!"}

{"step_index":2371,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T10:34:07Z","content":"Yes! Here is why it feels like a loop:\n\nIn Odoo, **any field you put in an XML view MUST exist in the Python model**.\n\nIn `res_users_signature_views.xml`:\n1. **User form view (`res.users`)** has:\n   ```xml\n   <field name=\"perm_export\" widget=\"radio\" string=\"Excel Export\"/>\n   <field name=\"perm_company\" widget=\"radio\" string=\"Company Creation\"/>\n   <field name=\"perm_equipment\" widget=\"radio\" string=\"Equipment Master\"/>\n   ```\n2. **Job / Role form view (`hr.job`)** also has:\n   ```xml\n   <field name=\"perm_export\" widget=\"radio\" string=\"Excel Export\"/>\n   <field name=\"perm_company\" widget=\"radio\" string=\"Company Creation\"/>\n   <field name=\"perm_equipment\" widget=\"radio\" string=\"Equipment Master\"/>\n   ```\n\nBecause **both XML views have these fields**, the fields **MUST be defined in BOTH Python classes**:\n- In `class ResUsers(models.Model):`\n- AND in `class HrJob(models.Model):`\n\nRight now, you have them in `HrJob` (lines 249–263), but you just deleted them from `ResUsers` (line 12). \n\nIf you leave them only in `HrJob`, Odoo will immediately fail on `res.users` with:\n`Field \"perm_export\" does not exist in model \"res.users\"`\n\n### The Solution:\nThey must stay in **both** classes. \n\nShall I restore the 3 fields into `class ResUsers` so both `ResUsers` and `HrJob` have them? Once both have them, Odoo will pass without any field error."}

{"step_index":2419,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T10:51:23Z","content":"I fixed it and pushed the changes (`d080b13`).\n\n### What changed:\nChanged `<xpath expr=\"//page[@name='access_rights']//group\" position=\"after\">` (which placed it right after the first top column group) to:\n```xml\n<xpath expr=\"//page[@name='access_rights']\" position=\"inside\">\n    <group string=\"Configuration &amp; Masters\">\n        <field name=\"perm_equipment\" string=\"Equipment Master\"/>\n        <field name=\"perm_company\" string=\"Company Creation\"/>\n    </group>\n</xpath>\n```\nNow `position=\"inside\"` appends it at the **very bottom** of the `Access Rights` tab, below both \"MASTER DATA\" and \"LEAD & QUOTATION\".\n\nPlease run on GCP SSH:\n```bash\ngit pull\nodoo-bin -c /etc/odoo.conf -d crm_data_test -u custom_crm_extended --stop-after-init\nsudo systemctl restart crm-test\n```"}

{"step_index":2422,"source":"MODEL","type":"SEARCH_WEB","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T10:52:41Z","content":"Created At: 2026-09-21T16:22:41+05:30\nCompleted At: 2026-09-21T16:22:45+05:30\nThe search for \"odoo base view_users_form access_rights xml structure groups\" returned the following summary:\nTo customize the `base.view_users_form` in Odoo (specifically within the **Access Rights** tab), you must inherit the view and target the correct XML structure using XPath.\n\n### **XML Structure and Inheritance**\nThe user form view is defined in the `base` module with the ID `view_users_form`. The \"Access Rights\" section is contained within a `notebook` page named `access_rights`.\n\n#### **Example: Inheriting and Modifying the View**\nTo add or modify fields (such as `groups_id`) within the Access Rights tab, use the following template:\n\n```xml\n<record id=\"view_users_form_inherit_custom\" model=\"ir.ui.view\">\n    <field name=\"name\">res.users.form.inherit.custom</field>\n    <field name=\"model\">res.users</field>\n    <field name=\"inherit_id\" ref=\"base.view_users_form\"/>\n    <field name=\"arch\" type=\"xml\">\n        <!-- Target the Access Rights page -->\n        <xpath expr=\"//page[@name='access_rights']\" position=\"inside\">\n            <group name=\"custom_group_section\" string=\"Custom Settings\">\n                <!-- Add your custom fields here -->\n                <field name=\"your_custom_field\"/>\n            </group>\n        </xpath>\n        \n        <!-- Example: Modifying the existing groups_id field -->\n        <xpath expr=\"//field[@name='groups_id']\" position=\"attributes\">\n            <attribute name=\"invisible\">1</attribute>\n        </xpath>\n    </field>\n</record>\n```\n\n### **Key Considerations**\n*   **Locating Fields:** If an XPath fails (e.g., `//field[@name='groups_id']`), ensure that no other module has hidden or renamed the field or the container. Use **Developer Mode** to inspect the form view architecture and verify the exact path.\n*   **Version Changes:** \n    *   **Odoo 16+:** The `groups_id` attribute on `ir.ui.view` has been deprecated/removed. Use `ir.model.access` records or domain-based security to control view access instead.\n    *   **Structure:** If you are having trouble targeting `groups_id`, it is often because it is nested within specific groups or categories inside the `access_rights` page.\n*   **Best Practices:**\n    *   Always verify your field exists on `res.users` and not `res.partner`.\n    *   If you need to show/hide fields based on user groups, use the `groups=\"module.group_xml_id\"` attribute directly on the field in your XML view.\n    *   For complex visibility logic, consider using a computed boolean field (e.g., `is_custom_admin`) and applying `invisible` attributes based on that field.\n\n### **Troubleshooting**\n*   **Validation Errors:** Ensure your module's `__manifest__.py` includes the security/view files in the correct order.\n*   **Field Not Appearing:** If your field does not show up, ensure your user has appropriate permissions and that the `access_rights` page is not being overridden or restricted by another inherited view. Use the \"View Architecture\" tool in Developer Mode to see the final combined XML after all inheritance is applied."}

{"step_index":2424,"source":"MODEL","type":"SEARCH_WEB","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T10:52:53Z","content":"Created At: 2026-09-21T16:22:53+05:30\nCompleted At: 2026-09-21T16:22:58+05:30\nThe search for \"\"Sales\" \"Products\" \"odoo\" \"view_users_form\" \"access_rights\" \"page\"\" returned the following summary:\nTo add or customize fields and settings within the **Access Rights** page of the Odoo user form (`base.view_users_form`), you typically use XML inheritance to target the page by its name[1][2][3].\n\n### Technical Implementation\n\nTo inject custom fields or groups into the **Access Rights** tab, inherit `base.view_users_form` and use an XPath expression to locate the `page` element[2][3].\n\n#### Example XML Inheritance\n```xml\n<record id=\"view_users_form_inherit_custom_access\" model=\"ir.ui.view\">\n    <field name=\"name\">res.users.form.inherit.access</field>\n    <field name=\"model\">res.users</field>\n    <field name=\"inherit_id\" ref=\"base.view_users_form\"/>\n    <field name=\"arch\" type=\"xml\">\n        <!-- Target the Access Rights page -->\n        <xpath expr=\"//page[@name='access_rights']\" position=\"inside\">\n            <group string=\"Custom Sales/Product Settings\">\n                <field name=\"your_custom_field\"/>\n            </group>\n        </xpath>\n    </field>\n</record>\n```\n\n### Key Considerations\n\n*   **Locating the Page:** The Access Rights tab is defined in the base view with `name=\"access_rights\"`[2][3]. Always use this attribute in your XPath to ensure stability across Odoo versions[1][2].\n*   **Permissions and Visibility:** If you are trying to restrict specific menu items (like \"Products\" in the Sales app) based on user groups, you do not necessarily need to modify `view_users_form`[4]. Instead:\n    *   **Menu Items:** Go to **Settings > Technical > User Interface > Menu Items**, search for the \"Products\" menu, and restrict it by adding specific groups[4].\n    *   **Record Rules:** If you need to restrict data access (e.g., hiding certain products), go to **Settings > Technical > Security > Record Rules** and define rules on the `product.template` or `product.product` model[5][6].\n*   **Developer Mode:** Always enable **Developer Mode** to inspect the exact structure of the form view and ensure your XPath target is correct[1][4].\n*   **Field Accessibility:** If you add a field to the `res.users` model, remember that Odoo often requires overriding the `__init__` method or adding the field to `SELF_READABLE_FIELDS` and `SELF_WRITEABLE_FIELDS` if the user should be able to edit it via their own profile[7].\n\nSources:\n[1] {"step_index":2435,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T10:53:25Z","content":"In standard Odoo, all the default sections (`MASTER DATA`, `LEAD & QUOTATION`, `WEBSITE`, `ACCOUNTING`, etc.) are rendered automatically inside one 2-column parent table/group.\n\nBecause you want **\"CONFIGURATION & MASTERS\"** to appear **immediately under the first two columns** (directly under `Master Data` & `Lead & Quotation`, above `Website`), we can do this cleanly in [user_access_labels.js](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/static/src/js/user_access_labels.js):\n\nIn the DOM, as soon as the Access Rights tab renders, it simply moves the `CONFIGURATION & MASTERS` group element so it sits directly below `Lead & Quotation` / `Master Data`.\n\nLet me add this 4-line DOM re-order to [user_access_labels.js](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/static/src/js/user_access_labels.js):\n\n```javascript\n// Position Configuration & Masters right below the first two columns\nconst configGroup = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(\".o_inner_group, .o_group\"))\n    .find(el => el.textContent.includes(\"Configuration & Masters\") || el.textContent.includes(\"CONFIGURATION & MASTERS\"));\nconst leadQuoteH = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(\".o_horizontal_separator\"))\n    .find(el => el.textContent.includes(\"Lead & Quotation\") || el.textContent.includes(\"LEAD & QUOTATION\"));\n\nif (configGroup && leadQuoteH) {\n    const parentContainer = leadQuoteH.closest(\".o_inner_group, .o_group\");\n    if (parentContainer && parentContainer.parentElement && configGroup.parentElement !== parentContainer.parentElement) {\n        parentContainer.parentElement.insertBefore(configGroup, parentContainer.nextSibling);\n    }\n}\n```\n\nShall I apply this update to [user_access_labels.js](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/static/src/js/user_access_labels.js) and sync it?"}

Quotation`.\n\nAlso, in Odoo views:\n- The left column is `Sales / Master Data`\n- The right column is `Lead & Quotation`\n- In XML, Odoo's access rights has a main `<group>` containing all the default categories. \n\nLet's put the movement inside `relabel()` so it actually executes when the DOM is ready.\n\nIn [user_access_labels.js](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/static/src/js/user_access_labels.js), here is the exact fix:\n\n```javascript\n                document.querySelectorAll(\".o_horizontal_separator\").forEach((h) => {\n                    const txt = h.textContent.trim().toUpperCase();\n                    if (txt === \"SALES\") {\n                        h.textContent = \"Lead & Quotation\";\n                    }\n                });\n\n                // Move Configuration & Masters right below the first two columns (Master Data / Lead & Quotation)\n                const configH = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(\".o_horizontal_separator\"))\n                    .find(h => h.textContent.toUpperCase().includes(\"CONFIGURATION & MASTERS\"));\n                const leadH = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(\".o_horizontal_separator\"))\n                    .find(h => h.textContent.toUpperCase().includes(\"LEAD & QUOTATION\"));\n\n                if (configH && leadH) {\n                    const configBox = configH.closest(\".o_inner_group\") || configH.closest(\".o_group\");\n                    const leadBox = leadH.closest(\".o_inner_group\") || leadH.closest(\".o_group\");\n                    if (configBox && leadBox && configBox.previousElementSibling !== leadBox) {\n                        leadBox.after(configBox);\n                    }\n                }\n            };\n```\n\nShall I apply this fix to [user_access_labels.js](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/static/src/js/user_access_labels.js)?"}

{"step_index":2458,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T10:59:33Z","content":"Here is the complete architecture breakdown for **Equipment Master, Service Ticket, and AMC**, along with how to implement the **\"Own Documents Only\"** permission.\n\n---\n\n### 1. Unified Architecture: Equipment ➔ AMC ➔ Service Ticket\n\nAll three models connect around the **Customer (`res.partner`)** and **Equipment (`equipment.master`)**:\n\n```\n                 +-----------------------+\n                 | Customer (res.partner)|\n                 +-----------+-----------+\n                             |\n                             v\n                 +-----------------------+\n                 |   Equipment Master    |  <--- Assets installed at customer\n                 |  (equipment.master)   |       Owner: user_id (Technician/Rep)\n                 +-----------+-----------+\n                             |\n              +--------------+--------------+\n              |                             |\n              v                             v\n   +--------------------+         +--------------------+\n   |    AMC Contract    |         |   Service Ticket   |\n   |   (amc.contract)   |         |  (service.ticket)  |\n   +--------------------+         +--------------------+\n```\n\n#### Relationship Keys:\n1. **Equipment Master (`equipment.master`)**:\n   - `user_id`: Assigned Service Engineer / Technician / Salesperson (defaults to `create_uid` or current user).\n   - `partner_id`: Customer who owns the machine.\n2. **AMC Contract (`amc.contract`)**:\n   - `equipment_id`: Linked equipment.\n   - `partner_id`: Customer.\n   - `user_id`: Account manager / Responsible engineer.\n3. **Service Ticket (`service.ticket`)**:\n   - `equipment_id`: Machine having the issue.\n   - `user_id`: Assigned engineer handling the ticket.\n   - Inherits customer and contract info directly from Equipment Master.\n\n---\n\n### 2. Permission Design for Equipment Master\n\nJust like Odoo’s standard Sales/CRM (`User: Own Documents Only` vs `User: All Documents` vs `Administrator`), we can update `perm_equipment` selection:\n\n```python\nperm_equipment = fields.Selection([\n    ('none', 'No'),\n    ('own', 'Own Records Only'),        # Can view/edit/delete only equipments assigned to them\n    ('all', 'All Records (View/Edit)'), # Can view & edit all equipments\n    ('admin', 'Administrator'),         # Full control including deleting & configuration\n], string='Equipment Master', default='own')\n```\n\n---\n\n### 3. How \"Own Records Only\" is enforced in Odoo (Record Rules)\n\nIn `security/ir.rule.xml`:\n\n1. **Rule for \"Own Records Only\"**:\n   ```xml\n   <record id=\"rule_equipment_master_user_own\" model=\"ir.rule\">\n       <field name=\"name\">Equipment: Own Records Only</field>\n       <field name=\"model_id\" ref=\"model_equipment_master\"/>\n       <field name=\"groups\" eval=\"[(4, ref('custom_crm_extended.group_equipment_user_own'))]\"/>\n       <field name=\"domain_force\">['|', ('user_id', '=', user.id), ('create_uid', '=', user.id)]</field>\n       <field name=\"perm_read\" eval=\"1\"/>\n       <field name=\"perm_write\" eval=\"1\"/>\n       <field name=\"perm_create\" eval=\"1\"/>\n       <field name=\"perm_unlink\" eval=\"1\"/>\n   </record>\n   ```\n\n2. **Rule for \"All Records\"**:\n   ```xml\n   <record id=\"rule_equipment_master_user_all\" model=\"ir.rule\">\n       <field name=\"name\">Equipment: All Records</field>\n       <field name=\"model_id\" ref=\"model_equipment_master\"/>\n       <field name=\"groups\" eval=\"[(4, ref('custom_crm_extended.group_equipment_user_all'))]\"/>\n       <field name=\"domain_force\">[(1, '=', 1)]</field>\n   </record>\n   ```\n\n3. **In `equipment.master` model**:\n   Add:\n   ```python\n   user_id = fields.Many2one('res.users', string='Assigned Engineer / Responsible', default=lambda self: self.env.user, tracking=True)\n   ```\n\n---\n\n### 4. AMC & Service Ticket Cascade\n\nWhen a user creates a **Service Ticket** or **AMC Contract**:\n- If a user has `own` access, their dropdown for Equipment will automatically filter to **only the equipment they are responsible for** (or at their assigned customer accounts).\n- When a ticket is created for an equipment, the assigned engineer on the ticket automatically defaults to the equipment's `user_id`.\n\nWould you like me to add `user_id` to `equipment.master` and update `perm_equipment` with `own` / `all` / `admin` options?"}

('user.perm_equipment', 'in', ['all', 'admin']),\n                '|', ('user_id', '=', user.id), ('create_uid', '=', user.id)\n            ]</field>\n        </record>\n```\n\nWhen a user has:\n- {"step_index":2484,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T11:07:47Z","content":"Got it! You want the **exact same standard Odoo group mechanism** as Lead & Quotation.\n\nHere is how **Lead & Quotation** works:\n1. It uses standard Odoo security groups:\n   - `group_sale_salesman` (Own Documents Only)\n   - `group_sale_salesman_all_leads` (All Documents)\n   - `group_sale_manager` (Administrator)\n2. In `_apply_job_permissions`, it simply inserts/removes the user into the matching group via `res_groups_users_rel`.\n3. Each group has a standard 1-line rule attached to it.\n\n---\n\nTo do the exact same thing for **Equipment Master**:\n\n### 1. Define the Groups & Rules in XML (Short & Clean)\n\nIn `addons/custom_crm_extended/security/multi_company_rules.xml`:\n\n```xml\n        <!-- Equipment Groups -->\n        <record id=\"group_equipment_own\" model=\"res.groups\">\n            <field name=\"name\">Equipment: Own Documents Only</field>\n            <field name=\"category_id\" ref=\"base.module_category_hidden\"/>\n        </record>\n\n        <record id=\"group_equipment_all\" model=\"res.groups\">\n            <field name=\"name\">Equipment: All Documents</field>\n            <field name=\"category_id\" ref=\"base.module_category_hidden\"/>\n        </record>\n\n        <!-- Rules for the groups -->\n        <record id=\"rule_equipment_own\" model=\"ir.rule\">\n            <field name=\"name\">Equipment: Own Documents Only</field>\n            <field name=\"model_id\" ref=\"model_equipment_master\"/>\n            <field name=\"groups\" eval=\"[(4, ref('group_equipment_own'))]\"/>\n            <field name=\"domain_force\">['|', ('user_id', '=', user.id), ('create_uid', '=', user.id)]</field>\n        </record>\n\n        <record id=\"rule_equipment_all\" model=\"ir.rule\">\n            <field name=\"name\">Equipment: All Documents</field>\n            <field name=\"model_id\" ref=\"model_equipment_master\"/>\n            <field name=\"groups\" eval=\"[(4, ref('group_equipment_all'))]\"/>\n            <field name=\"domain_force\">[(1, '=', 1)]</field>\n        </record>\n```\n\n---\n\n### 2. In `res_users.py` (`_apply_job_permissions`):\nThe exact same 5-line logic as `perm_lead_quote`:\n\n```python\n            # Equipment Master permissions\n            g_eq_own = self.env.ref('custom_crm_extended.group_equipment_own', raise_if_not_found=False)\n            g_eq_all = self.env.ref('custom_crm_extended.group_equipment_all', raise_if_not_found=False)\n\n            if g_eq_own and g_eq_all:\n                self.env.cr.execute(\"DELETE FROM res_groups_users_rel WHERE uid = %s AND gid IN (%s, %s)\", (user.id, g_eq_own.id, g_eq_all.id))\n                if job.perm_equipment == 'own':\n                    self.env.cr.execute(\"INSERT INTO res_groups_users_rel (gid, uid) VALUES (%s, %s) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING\", (g_eq_own.id, user.id))\n                elif job.perm_equipment in ('all', 'admin'):\n                    self.env.cr.execute(\"INSERT INTO res_groups_users_rel (gid, uid) VALUES (%s, %s) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING\", (g_eq_all.id, user.id))\n```\n\nThis is the exact clean mechanism used by Lead & Quotation:\n- Group defines the rule\n- Selecting the dropdown adds/removes the user from the group."}

{"step_index":2518,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T11:23:27Z","content":"Here is why both issues happen and the clean solution for each:\n\n---\n\n### Issue 1: Why it auto scrolls up when you open a dropdown\nIn `user_access_labels.js`, there is a `MutationObserver`:\n```javascript\nobserver = new MutationObserver(relabel);\nobserver.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });\n```\nWhen you click any dropdown in Odoo, Odoo inserts the dropdown menu popup into `document.body`. \nThe `MutationObserver` detects that insertion and immediately runs `relabel()`, which executes:\n```javascript\nleadBox.after(configBox);\n```\n**Moving a DOM element (`.after()`) forces the browser to re-layout and reset the scroll position to the top!**\n\n#### The Fix for Scrolling:\n1. Don't move the DOM repeatedly inside the MutationObserver. Move it **only once** when the form loads, or only if it's not already in place.\n2. Even better: observe only the form sheet container `document.querySelector('.o_form_sheet')` instead of the whole `document.body`, so dropdown popups don't trigger it at all.\n\n---\n\n### Issue 2: Why it affects all dropdown menus across the website\nIn `user_access_labels.js`, the label text search:\n```javascript\ndocument.querySelectorAll(\"label.o_form_label\").forEach(...)\n```\nand\n```javascript\ndocument.querySelectorAll(\".o_horizontal_separator\").forEach(...)\n```\nruns across the entire page without scoping to the user access rights tab.\n\n#### The Fix for Scope:\nScope the selector strictly to the user form's Access Rights tab:\n```javascript\nconst accessTab = document.querySelector(\".o_notebook .tab-pane\"); // or [name='access_rights']\n```\nWhen scoped strictly to `.o_form_sheet`, it will **never touch or conflict with website dropdowns or any other menus**.\n\n---\n\n### Summary of what to change:\nNo Python or XML files need changes. Only `user_access_labels.js` needs to:\n1. Stop observing `document.body` (observe only `.o_form_sheet`).\n2. Only run DOM repositioning once using a flag (`hasMoved`), so clicking dropdowns never causes a re-layout or scroll jump."}

{"step_index":2522,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T11:27:41Z","content":"Here is the clean, fixed version that completely eliminates the scroll jump and protects all dropdowns across the site:\n\n### What was fixed:\n1. **No Scroll Jump**: Only moves the box once (`hasMoved` flag). Opening/closing dropdowns will never trigger a DOM movement or scroll reset.\n2. **Strict Scoping**: Instead of querying the entire `document.body`, it scopes all label searches strictly to `.o_form_sheet`, so other website/system dropdowns are completely untouched.\n3. **Dropdown Safe Observer**: Ignores dropdown popup insertions (`.o-dropdown--menu`, `.dropdown-menu`).\n\n---\n\n```javascript\n/** @odoo-module **/\nimport { patch } from \"@web/core/utils/patch\";\nimport { FormController } from \"@web/views/form/form_controller\";\nimport { onMounted, onPatched, onWillUnmount } from \"@odoo/owl\";\n\npatch(FormController.prototype, {\n    setup() {\n        super.setup(...arguments);\n        if (this.props.resModel === \"res.users\") {\n            const labelMap = {\n                \"Sales\": \"Lead & Quotation\",\n                \"Products\": \"Product Catalog\",\n                \"Contact\": \"Contact Creation\",\n                \"Export\": \"Excel Export\",\n            };\n\n            let hasMoved = false;\n\n            const relabel = () => {\n                const sheet = document.querySelector(\".o_form_sheet\");\n                if (!sheet) return;\n\n                // 1. Relabel field labels strictly inside the user form sheet\n                sheet.querySelectorAll(\"label.o_form_label\").forEach((lbl) => {\n                    const firstText = Array.from(lbl.childNodes)\n                        .filter(node => node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE)\n                        .map(node => node.textContent.trim())\n                        .join(\"\");\n\n                    if (labelMap[firstText]) {\n                        for (let node of lbl.childNodes) {\n                            if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && node.textContent.trim() === firstText) {\n                                node.textContent = labelMap[firstText] + \" \";\n                                break;\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                });\n\n                // 2. Relabel section header strictly inside form sheet\n                sheet.querySelectorAll(\".o_horizontal_separator\").forEach((h) => {\n                    if (h.textContent.trim().toUpperCase() === \"SALES\") {\n                        h.textContent = \"Lead & Quotation\";\n                    }\n                });\n\n                // 3. Position Configuration & Masters ONCE (prevents scroll jump on dropdown clicks)\n                if (!hasMoved) {\n                    const configH = Array.from(sheet.querySelectorAll(\".o_horizontal_separator\"))\n                        .find(h => h.textContent.toUpperCase().includes(\"CONFIGURATION & MASTERS\"));\n                    const leadH = Array.from(sheet.querySelectorAll(\".o_horizontal_separator\"))\n                        .find(h => h.textContent.toUpperCase().includes(\"LEAD & QUOTATION\"));\n\n                    if (configH && leadH) {\n                        const configBox = configH.closest(\".o_inner_group\") || configH.closest(\".o_group\");\n                        const leadBox = leadH.closest(\".o_inner_group\") || leadH.closest(\".o_group\");\n                        if (configBox && leadBox && configBox.previousElementSibling !== leadBox) {\n                            leadBox.after(configBox);\n                            hasMoved = true;\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            };\n\n            let observer = null;\n            onMounted(() => {\n                hasMoved = false;\n                relabel();\n                const sheet = document.querySelector(\".o_form_sheet\");\n                if (sheet) {\n                    observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {\n                        // Ignore dropdown menu additions so clicking dropdown never triggers a re-layout\n                        const isDropdown = mutations.some(m => \n                            Array.from(m.addedNodes).some(n => n.classList && (n.classList.contains(\"dropdown-menu\") || n.classList.contains(\"o-dropdown--menu\")))\n                        );\n                        if (!isDropdown) {\n                            relabel();\n                        }\n                    });\n                    observer.observe(sheet, { childList: true, subtree: true });\n                }\n            });\n\n            onPatched(() => {\n                relabel();\n            });\n\n            onWillUnmount(() => {\n                if (observer) observer.disconnect();\n            });\n        }\n    },\n});\n```\n\nWould you like me to replace the file with this clean version?"}

{"step_index":2529,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T11:28:26Z","content":"`accessTab` was removed. \n\nTo also fix the **auto-scrolling jump** when opening dropdowns, look at line 52:\n```javascript\nif (configBox && leadBox && configBox.previousElementSibling !== leadBox) {\n    leadBox.after(configBox);\n}\n```\nBecause `leadBox` and `configBox` are in a 2-column flex/grid container, `configBox.previousElementSibling` might never match `leadBox` directly, so every time you open a dropdown, Odoo triggers DOM updates and this line runs repeatedly — forcing the page to re-render and scroll up!\n\nLet's prevent repeated execution by setting a flag `hasMoved = true`:\n\n```javascript\n                    if (configBox && leadBox && !configBox.dataset.repositioned) {\n                        leadBox.after(configBox);\n                        configBox.dataset.repositioned = \"true\";\n                    }\n```\n\nOnce it moves once, `configBox.dataset.repositioned` is `\"true\"`:\n- Clicking dropdowns will **never** re-move the box.\n- The scroll position will **never** jump up.\n\nShall I apply this fix to [user_access_labels.js](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/static/src/js/user_access_labels.js)?"}

{"step_index":2557,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T11:34:57Z","content":"To place it cleanly **without using any JS DOM manipulation** (which avoids all scroll jumping, dropdown interference, and timing issues), we can use the exact native Odoo XML view!\n\n### The Native XML Solution:\n\nIn standard Odoo (`base.view_users_form`), the Access Rights tab has a root `<group>` that contains all application groups (Sales, Inventory, Website, Accounting, etc.).\n\nInstead of `position=\"inside\"` (which puts it at the very bottom), we can place it right inside that root `<group>` at the top.\n\nIn [res_users_signature_views.xml](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/views/res_users_signature_views.xml), change lines 54–59 to:\n\n```xml\n            <xpath expr=\"//page[@name='access_rights']/group[1]\" position=\"inside\">\n                <group string=\"Configuration &amp; Masters\">\n                    <field name=\"perm_equipment\" string=\"Equipment Master\"/>\n                    <field name=\"perm_company\" string=\"Company Creation\"/>\n                </group>\n            </xpath>\n```\n\n### Why this is 100% better:\n1. Native Odoo renders it right inside the 2-column grid directly under Master Data / Lead & Quotation.\n2. **Zero JavaScript** needed for repositioning, so **no scroll jump**, **no dropdown bug**, and **no lag**.\n\n---\n\nAnd in [user_access_labels.js](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/static/src/js/user_access_labels.js), you can completely remove the repositioning code and keep only the label text renaming:\n\n```javascript\n/** @odoo-module **/\nimport { patch } from \"@web/core/utils/patch\";\nimport { FormController } from \"@web/views/form/form_controller\";\nimport { onMounted, onPatched, onWillUnmount } from \"@odoo/owl\";\n\npatch(FormController.prototype, {\n    setup() {\n        super.setup(...arguments);\n        if (this.props.resModel === \"res.users\") {\n            const labelMap = {\n                \"Sales\": \"Lead & Quotation\",\n                \"Products\": \"Product Catalog\",\n                \"Contact\": \"Contact Creation\",\n                \"Export\": \"Excel Export\",\n            };\n\n            const relabel = () => {\n                document.querySelectorAll(\"label.o_form_label\").forEach((lbl) => {\n                    const firstText = Array.from(lbl.childNodes)\n                        .filter(node => node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE)\n                        .map(node => node.textContent.trim())\n                        .join(\"\");\n\n                    if (labelMap[firstText]) {\n                        for (let node of lbl.childNodes) {\n                            if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && node.textContent.trim() === firstText) {\n                                node.textContent = labelMap[firstText] + \" \";\n                                break;\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                });\n\n                document.querySelectorAll(\".o_horizontal_separator\").forEach((h) => {\n                    const txt = h.textContent.trim().toUpperCase();\n                    if (txt === \"SALES\") {\n                        h.textContent = \"Lead & Quotation\";\n                    }\n                });\n            };\n\n            let observer = null;\n            onMounted(() => {\n                relabel();\n                observer = new MutationObserver(relabel);\n                observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });\n            });\n\n            onPatched(relabel);\n\n            onWillUnmount(() => {\n                if (observer) observer.disconnect();\n            });\n        }\n    },\n});\n```\n\nShall I apply this clean XML & JS setup?"}

{"step_index":2597,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T11:48:28Z","content":"Look at your screenshot now:\n- **Left Column**: `MASTER DATA`, then immediately below it: `CONFIGURATION & MASTERS` (half-width, exactly matching Master Data!), then `ACCOUNTING`, then `MARKETING`.\n- **Right Column**: `LEAD & QUOTATION`, then `WEBSITE`, then `PRODUCTIVITY`, then `HUMAN RESOURCES`.\n\nIt looks completely clean and balanced in 2 equal columns!\n\n---\n\n### Answering your question: Can this be done ONLY via XML without JS?\n\n**YES, 100%!**\n\nBecause Odoo's base view has:\n```xml\n<page name=\"access_rights\">\n    <group>\n        <!-- all category groups are inside here -->\n    </group>\n</page>\n```\n\nIf you do it **ONLY via XML**:\nIn `res_users_signature_views.xml`:\n```xml\n<xpath expr=\"//page[@name='access_rights']/group[1]\" position=\"inside\">\n    <group string=\"Configuration &amp; Masters\">\n        <field name=\"perm_equipment\" string=\"Equipment Master\"/>\n        <field name=\"perm_company\" string=\"Company Creation\"/>\n    </group>\n</xpath>\n```\n\nAnd in `user_access_labels.js`, you **completely delete** lines 43–55 (the JS move code).\n\n### Benefits of the XML-Only solution:\n1. **0 JavaScript manipulation**: Native Odoo renders it directly where it belongs.\n2. **Never any scroll jump** when clicking dropdowns.\n3. **Faster page load** and 100% stable.\n\nWould you like to switch to the pure XML-only solution?"}

{"step_index":2602,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T11:51:06Z","content":"Here are the **4 clear architectural options** available in Odoo to solve this once and for all:\n\n---\n\n### Option 1: Native XML with an Exact Anchor (Recommended)\n* **How it works:** Instead of guessing positions like `position=\"inside\"` or `group[1]`, we target an exact field that already exists inside the left column in Odoo (for example, target the field under `Master Data` or `Lead & Quotation` directly using `<xpath expr=\"//field[@name='...']\" position=\"after\">`).\n* **Pros:** 100% native Odoo XML. No JavaScript needed at all. Never jumps, never breaks dropdowns, and loads instantly.\n* **Cons:** Requires checking the exact technical name of the field in that group in Developer Mode.\n\n---\n\n### Option 2: Place them in their own dedicated Tab (\"Configuration & Masters\")\n* **How it works:** Add a brand new tab right next to *Access Rights*, *Preferences*, and *Organization & Hierarchy* called **\"Configuration & Masters\"**.\n* **Pros:** \n  - Zero conflict with Odoo's complex core Access Rights layout.\n  - Zero JavaScript needed.\n  - Very clean, professional, and easy to find all custom system permissions (Equipment, Company Creation, etc.) in one dedicated place.\n* **Cons:** It's in a separate tab rather than inside the Access Rights tab.\n\n---\n\n### Option 3: CSS-only Grid Ordering (Pure CSS, 0 JS)\n* **How it works:** Keep the XML simple at the bottom of the tab, but add a simple 2-line CSS rule using CSS `order`:\n  `order: 2;` on the Configuration & Masters card.\n* **Pros:** \n  - Visual layout moves immediately without any DOM manipulation.\n  - Doesn't cause scroll jumping because elements are not being moved in the DOM tree.\n  - Dropdowns never reset.\n* **Cons:** Requires a small CSS rule in the backend assets.\n\n---\n\n### Option 4: Put them inside \"Organization & Hierarchy\" Tab\n* **How it works:** Since Job Position, Manager, Department, and Employee Profile are already in the \"Organization & Hierarchy\" tab, place Equipment Master and Company Creation there right alongside the role settings.\n* **Pros:** 100% stable XML, groups naturally with employee/user setup.\n* **Cons:** Not in the first \"Access Rights\" tab.\n\n---\n\nWhich of these 4 options would you prefer to go with?"}

{"step_index":2604,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T11:51:37Z","content":"Here are the **different UI Layout design options** for how to present these permissions visually to the user:\n\n---\n\n### Layout Option A: 2-Column Split Cards (Modern Dashboard Card Style)\n* **Visual Structure:**\n  - Instead of standard plain text lists, permissions are grouped into distinct white cards with rounded borders and subtle headers:\n    - **Card 1 (Left Top):** `Master Data` (Product Catalog, Contact Creation, Excel Export)\n    - **Card 2 (Right Top):** `Lead & Quotation` (Lead & Quotation Access)\n    - **Card 3 (Left Bottom):** `Configuration & Masters` (Equipment Master, Company Creation)\n    - **Card 4 (Right Bottom):** Other core system apps (Website, Accounting, etc.)\n* **Look & Feel:** Clean modern CRM card layout, perfectly balanced 50% / 50% columns, no shifting.\n\n---\n\n### Layout Option B: Single Unified Permissions Matrix / Table Layout\n* **Visual Structure:**\n  - A clean, compact table/grid directly at the top of the tab:\n    | Module / Feature | Permission Level | Scope |\n    | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n    | **Lead & Quotation** | `[Administrator ▾]` | Sales & Quotes |\n    | **Equipment Master** | `[User: Own Documents Only ▾]` | Assets & Service |\n    | **Company Creation** | `[No ▾]` | Multi-Company |\n    | **Excel Export** | `[No ▾]` | Reports & Data |\n    | **Contact Creation** | `[Creation ▾]` | Customers & Vendors |\n    | **Product Catalog** | `[View ▾]` | Products & Pricing |\n* **Look & Feel:** High-density enterprise style (like AWS/Salesforce IAM permission matrix). Everything is in one neat, compact table at a glance without scattered headers.\n\n---\n\n### Layout Option C: Toggle Switch Badges / Pill Tags Style\n* **Visual Structure:**\n  - For Yes/No rights (Excel Export, Company Creation), render them as modern **Toggle Switches** or **Pill Badges** (Green `Enabled` / Gray `Disabled`).\n  - For multi-level rights (Lead & Quotation, Equipment Master), render them as segmented pill buttons (`[No] [Own] [All] [Admin]`).\n* **Look & Feel:** Modern SaaS feel (like Linear, Notion, or Stripe settings). Very visual and fast to toggle without dropdown menus.\n\n---\n\n### Layout Option D: Accordion / Collapsible Category Sections\n* **Visual Structure:**\n  - Collapsible horizontal banners:\n    - `▶ Sales & CRM Permissions` (Lead & Quotation, Contacts, Products)\n    - `▶ Operations & Assets Permissions` (Equipment Master, Service Tickets, AMC)\n    - `▶ Admin & System Permissions` (Company Creation, Excel Export)\n* **Look & Feel:** Highly organized for scalability when more modules (AMC, Tickets, Service) are added later.\n\n---\n\nWhich layout style fits your vision best?"}

{"step_index":2612,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T11:54:47Z","content":"Here is the exact code to make them **Horizontal Radio Buttons** with a **Custom Color**:\n\n---\n\n### Step 1: Update XML with `widget=\"radio\"` and `options=\"{'horizontal': true}\"`\n\nIn [res_users_signature_views.xml](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/views/res_users_signature_views.xml), replace lines 54–62 with:\n\n```xml\n            <xpath expr=\"//page[@name='access_rights']/group[1]\" position=\"inside\">\n                <group>\n                    <group string=\"Configuration &amp; Masters\" class=\"crm-custom-radio-group\">\n                        <field name=\"perm_equipment\" widget=\"radio\" options=\"{'horizontal': true}\" string=\"Equipment Master\"/>\n                        <field name=\"perm_company\" widget=\"radio\" options=\"{'horizontal': true}\" string=\"Company Creation\"/>\n                    </group>\n                    <group/>\n                </group>\n            </xpath>\n```\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Custom Colors & Clean Horizontal Styling\n\nAdd this CSS to your assets (or directly in `custom_crm_extended/static/src/css/` or inside your dashboard CSS):\n\n```css\n/* Custom Horizontal Radio Buttons */\n.crm-custom-radio-group .o_radio_item {\n    display: inline-flex !important;\n    align-items: center !important;\n    margin-right: 18px !important;\n    cursor: pointer;\n}\n\n/* Custom Radio Dot Color (Vibrant Indigo / Purple Accent) */\n.crm-custom-radio-group input[type=\"radio\"]:checked {\n    background-color: #6366f1 !important;\n    border-color: #4f46e5 !important;\n    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25) !important;\n}\n\n.crm-custom-radio-group input[type=\"radio\"] {\n    width: 16px !important;\n    height: 16px !important;\n    accent-color: #6366f1 !important;\n    cursor: pointer;\n}\n\n.crm-custom-radio-group .form-check-label {\n    font-weight: 500 !important;\n    color: #374151 !important;\n    margin-left: 6px !important;\n    cursor: pointer;\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n### Result:\n- Both fields render **completely horizontal** side-by-side (`(o) No   ( ) Own   ( ) All   ( ) Admin`).\n- No dropdowns, no popup menus, no scroll jumping.\n- Styled with a modern indigo accent color `#6366f1` instead of the standard default color.\n\nShall I apply this update to [res_users_signature_views.xml](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/views/res_users_signature_views.xml)?"}

{"step_index":2614,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T11:55:16Z","content":"In Odoo, **all** the fields in the Access Rights tab (`Lead & Quotation`, `Product Catalog`, `Contact Creation`, etc.) are rendered by Odoo using the exact same standard radio / selection widget!\n\nWe can apply the **horizontal layout and custom color across ALL fields** in the Access Rights tab using pure CSS or by targeting the parent tab:\n\n---\n\n### Option A: Pure CSS (Applies custom horizontal radios to ALL fields in Access Rights)\n\nAdd this CSS rule to style the entire Access Rights tab:\n\n```css\n/* Make ALL radio selections in Access Rights tab horizontal */\n.tab-pane[name=\"access_rights\"] .o_field_radio,\n.o_notebook .tab-pane:first-child .o_field_radio {\n    display: flex !important;\n    flex-direction: row !important;\n    flex-wrap: wrap !important;\n    gap: 16px !important;\n}\n\n.tab-pane[name=\"access_rights\"] .o_radio_item,\n.o_notebook .tab-pane:first-child .o_radio_item {\n    display: inline-flex !important;\n    align-items: center !important;\n    margin-bottom: 0 !important;\n    cursor: pointer !important;\n}\n\n/* Custom Radio Dot Color for ALL fields */\n.tab-pane[name=\"access_rights\"] input[type=\"radio\"],\n.o_notebook .tab-pane:first-child input[type=\"radio\"] {\n    width: 16px !important;\n    height: 16px !important;\n    accent-color: #6366f1 !important; /* Custom Indigo/Purple Color */\n    cursor: pointer !important;\n}\n\n.tab-pane[name=\"access_rights\"] input[type=\"radio\"]:checked,\n.o_notebook .tab-pane:first-child input[type=\"radio\"]:checked {\n    background-color: #6366f1 !important;\n    border-color: #4f46e5 !important;\n    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25) !important;\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n### Why this is the best approach:\n1. **Zero XML changes needed** for the standard Odoo fields (`Sales`, `Products`, `Accounting`, etc.).\n2. Every single field in the tab automatically converts from vertical to **clean horizontal inline radio buttons**.\n3. All buttons share the exact same modern custom accent color (`#6366f1`).\n4. Completely consistent look across both custom and default Odoo fields.\n\nShall I add this CSS file and link it to the assets?"}

{"step_index":2625,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T12:04:25Z","content":"Now I see the screenshot clearly! \n\nLook at what Odoo is doing:\n1. `Product Catalog`, `Contact Creation`, `Lead & Quotation`, `Website`, `Accounting` are **dropdowns / selection fields (`<select>` or `.o_field_selection`)** in Odoo! They are NOT radios by default.\n2. Only `Equipment Master` and `Company Creation` became radios because you added `widget=\"radio\"`, and they are squished horizontally together without spacing!\n\n### You want ALL fields (Product Catalog, Lead & Quotation, Website, Accounting, etc.) to look IDENTICAL.\n\nThere are two consistent ways:\n\n---\n\n### Solution 1: All Dropdowns (Clean, Native Odoo Standard)\nMake `Equipment Master` and `Company Creation` normal dropdowns just like all the others above them:\n- Remove `widget=\"radio\"`.\n- Then **every single field** on the entire page has the exact same dropdown style with identical height and alignment.\n\n---\n\n### Solution 2: All Horizontal Radios (Custom Widget in XML)\nIf you truly want **all default Odoo fields** (Sales, Products, Website, etc.) to be horizontal radio buttons:\nIn Odoo XML, the default groups are defined as selection fields. To make them radios, each one in the inherited XML view must be set to `widget=\"radio\"`:\n```xml\n<xpath expr=\"//field[@name='...']\" position=\"attributes\">\n    <attribute name=\"widget\">radio</attribute>\n</xpath>\n```\nAND the radio options need proper spacing so they don't overlap (like `No(o)User: Own Documents Only` in your screenshot).\n\n---\n\nWhich do you prefer?\n- **Option 1**: Keep **all of them as clean dropdowns** (standard Odoo)?\n- **Option 2**: Convert **all default fields to spaced horizontal radio buttons** in XML?"}

{"step_index":2631,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T12:05:20Z","content":"To convert **all fields** into clean, well-spaced horizontal radio buttons, here is the complete solution:\n\n---\n\n### Step 1: Add `options=\"{'horizontal': true}\"` and spacing in [res_users_signature_views.xml](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/views/res_users_signature_views.xml)\n\nIn `res_users_signature_views.xml`, lines 54–62:\n\n```xml\n            <xpath expr=\"//page[@name='access_rights']/group[1]\" position=\"inside\">\n                <group>\n                    <group string=\"Configuration &amp; Masters\">\n                        <field name=\"perm_equipment\" widget=\"radio\" options=\"{'horizontal': true}\" string=\"Equipment Master\"/>\n                        <field name=\"perm_company\" widget=\"radio\" options=\"{'horizontal': true}\" string=\"Company Creation\"/>\n                    </group>\n                    <group/>\n                </group>\n            </xpath>\n```\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Fix the CSS in [crm_hide_new.css](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/static/src/css/crm_hide_new.css)\n*(The reason `No` and `(o)` were squished together with the next label was missing margins on Odoo 18 `.form-check` elements)*.\n\nReplace lines 400–431 in `addons/custom_crm_extended/static/src/css/crm_hide_new.css` with:\n\n```css\n/* Clean Horizontal Spacing for Radio Buttons in Access Rights */\n.o_field_radio, \n.o_field_radio .o_radio_input, \n.o_field_radio .form-check {\n    display: inline-flex !important;\n    align-items: center !important;\n    margin-right: 18px !important;\n    margin-bottom: 4px !important;\n    gap: 6px !important;\n}\n\n.o_field_radio .form-check-label {\n    margin-left: 5px !important;\n    margin-right: 12px !important;\n    font-weight: 500 !important;\n    color: #374151 !important;\n    cursor: pointer !important;\n}\n\n/* Custom Radio Dot Color (#6366f1 Indigo) */\n.o_field_radio input[type=\"radio\"] {\n    width: 16px !important;\n    height: 16px !important;\n    accent-color: #6366f1 !important;\n    cursor: pointer !important;\n}\n\n.o_field_radio input[type=\"radio\"]:checked {\n    background-color: #6366f1 !important;\n    border-color: #4f46e5 !important;\n    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25) !important;\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n### Step 3: Automatically Render Default Odoo Dropdowns as Radios\n\nIn Odoo, default access fields are virtual `sel_groups_...` selection fields. In [user_access_labels.js](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/static/src/js/user_access_labels.js), we can tell the view to render selection fields as radio buttons, OR target them in XML:\n\n```xml\n            <xpath expr=\"//page[@name='access_rights']//field\" position=\"attributes\">\n                <attribute name=\"widget\">radio</attribute>\n                <attribute name=\"options\">{'horizontal': true}</attribute>\n            </xpath>\n```\n\nShall I apply Steps 1 and 2 right now so the radio spacing and custom color look completely clean?"}

{"step_index":2635,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T12:06:23Z","content":"I hear you completely. You want **EVERY SINGLE FIELD on that entire Access Rights page** (Lead & Quotation, Product Catalog, Contact Creation, Excel Export, Website, Accounting, Marketing, Productivity, HR, and Equipment/Company):\n1. To be a **horizontal radio button**.\n2. To use your **custom color**.\n3. With proper spacing so nothing overlaps.\n\nIn Odoo, those other fields are dynamically generated selection fields (`sel_groups_...`).\nBecause they are generated dynamically by Odoo's backend, standard XML view tags can't target all of them individually.\n\nTo turn **every single field on the page** into horizontal radio buttons with your custom color:\n\nWe can convert them in [user_access_labels.js](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/static/src/js/user_access_labels.js) so every `<select>` / dropdown on the Access Rights tab turns into a row of custom-colored horizontal radio buttons:\n\n```javascript\n// Convert every single dropdown in the Access Rights page into custom horizontal radio buttons\ndocument.querySelectorAll(\".tab-pane:first-child .o_field_selection select, .tab-pane[name='access_rights'] .o_field_selection select\").forEach(select => {\n    if (select.dataset.convertedToRadio) return;\n    select.dataset.convertedToRadio = \"true\";\n    select.style.display = \"none\";\n\n    const radioContainer = document.createElement(\"div\");\n    radioContainer.className = \"crm-custom-radios d-inline-flex align-items-center flex-wrap gap-3\";\n\n    Array.from(select.options).forEach(opt => {\n        const label = document.createElement(\"label\");\n        label.className = \"d-inline-flex align-items-center gap-1 mb-0 me-3 cursor-pointer\";\n\n        const input = document.createElement(\"input\");\n        input.type = \"radio\";\n        input.name = select.name || select.id || Math.random();\n        input.value = opt.value;\n        input.checked = opt.selected;\n        input.className = \"crm-radio-dot\";\n\n        input.addEventListener(\"change\", () => {\n            select.value = opt.value;\n            select.dispatchEvent(new Event(\"change\", { bubbles: true }));\n        });\n\n        label.appendChild(input);\n        label.appendChild(document.createTextNode(\" \" + opt.text));\n        radioContainer.appendChild(label);\n    });\n\n    select.after(radioContainer);\n});\n```\n\nAnd in [crm_hide_new.css](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/static/src/css/crm_hide_new.css):\n\n```css\n/* Custom Radio Buttons across the ENTIRE page */\n.crm-radio-dot,\n.o_field_radio input[type=\"radio\"] {\n    width: 16px !important;\n    height: 16px !important;\n    accent-color: #6366f1 !important;\n    cursor: pointer !important;\n    margin: 0 !important;\n}\n\n.crm-custom-radios label,\n.o_field_radio .form-check {\n    display: inline-flex !important;\n    align-items: center !important;\n    margin-right: 18px !important;\n    margin-bottom: 2px !important;\n    gap: 6px !important;\n    font-weight: 500 !important;\n    color: #374151 !important;\n    cursor: pointer !important;\n}\n```\n\nThis transforms **ALL fields on the page** (default Odoo fields + custom fields) into identical, beautifully spaced, custom-colored horizontal radio buttons.\n\nShall I apply this right now?"}

{"step_index":2656,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T12:11:31Z","content":"In the second image (the **single user page**):\n\nNotice that on `Equipment Master`, the 4 options:\n- `No`\n- `User: Own Documents Only`\n- `User: All Documents`\n- `Administrator`\n\nwere wrapping awkwardly across 2 lines (`Administrator` was dropped down below) because the left half-column is only 50% width!\n\nIn the first image (Roles & Groups), it is full width, so the radio buttons have plenty of room.\n\nTo make the second image look clean and not break onto uneven lines:\n\nIn [res_users_signature_views.xml](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/views/res_users_signature_views.xml), remove `<group/>` so `Configuration & Masters` gets full width across the bottom of that row:\n\n```xml\n            <xpath expr=\"//page[@name='access_rights']/group[1]\" position=\"inside\">\n                <group string=\"Configuration &amp; Masters\">\n                    <field name=\"perm_equipment\" widget=\"radio\" options=\"{'horizontal': true}\" string=\"Equipment Master\"/>\n                    <field name=\"perm_company\" widget=\"radio\" options=\"{'horizontal': true}\" string=\"Company Creation\"/>\n                </group>\n            </xpath>\n```\n\nWith `options=\"{'horizontal': true}\"` and full width:\nAll 4 radio options (`No`, `User: Own Documents Only`, `User: All Documents`, `Administrator`) sit on **one single clean horizontal line** with comfortable spacing, just like in image 1.\n\nShall I apply this to [res_users_signature_views.xml](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/views/res_users_signature_views.xml)?"}

The right column has `perm_equipment` squished in the same column as `Excel Export` and `Company Creation`.\n\n---\n\n### The Clean Fix\n\nTo give **`Lead & Quotation`** and **`Equipment Master`** enough horizontal room so all 4 options stay on **ONE clean row**:\nRender the 4-option fields (`Lead & Quotation` and `Equipment Master`) across full width, or layout the 6 permissions cleanly:\n\nIn [res_users_signature_views.xml](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/views/res_users_signature_views.xml), replace lines 82–93 with:\n\n```xml\n                <group string=\"Permissions\">\n                    <field name=\"perm_lead_quote\" widget=\"radio\" options=\"{'horizontal': true}\"/>\n                    <field name=\"perm_equipment\" widget=\"radio\" options=\"{'horizontal': true}\"/>\n                    <group>\n                        <field name=\"perm_contact\" widget=\"radio\" options=\"{'horizontal': true}\"/>\n                        <field name=\"perm_product\" widget=\"radio\" options=\"{'horizontal': true}\"/>\n                    </group>\n                    <group>\n                        <field name=\"perm_export\" widget=\"radio\" options=\"{'horizontal': true}\"/>\n                        <field name=\"perm_company\" widget=\"radio\" options=\"{'horizontal': true}\"/>\n                    </group>\n                </group>\n```\n\n### Result:\n- **`Lead & Quotation`**: Gets full width across the top, so `No`, `User: Own Documents Only`, `User: All Documents`, `Administrator` sit on **one single straight line**.\n- **`Equipment Master`**: Gets full width directly beneath it, so all 4 options also sit on **one single straight line**.\n- **The shorter fields** (`Contact Creation`, `Product Catalog`, `Excel Export`, `Company Creation`) sit neatly in 2 balanced columns below!\n\nShall I apply this layout to [res_users_signature_views.xml](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/views/res_users_signature_views.xml)?"}

{"step_index":2705,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T12:36:25Z","content":"Here is the CSS code to give the radio buttons your custom brand theme (matching the navy/blue theme `#0b3d91` / `#1769aa` used across the CRM system, Service Ticket & Equipment Master), complete with custom border, checked state, and hover styling.\n\nAdd this directly to the end of [addons/custom_crm_extended/static/src/css/crm_hide_new.css](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/static/src/css/crm_hide_new.css):\n\n```css\n/* Custom Radio Button Theme for Roles & Permissions */\n.o_field_radio {\n    display: inline-flex !important;\n    align-items: center !important;\n    flex-wrap: wrap !important;\n    gap: 16px !important;\n}\n\n.o_field_radio .form-check {\n    display: inline-flex !important;\n    align-items: center !important;\n    margin-right: 18px !important;\n    margin-bottom: 2px !important;\n    cursor: pointer !important;\n}\n\n/* Custom Radio Circle & Border */\n.o_field_radio input[type=\"radio\"] {\n    appearance: none !important;\n    -webkit-appearance: none !important;\n    width: 17px !important;\n    height: 17px !important;\n    border: 2px solid #94a3b8 !important; /* Clean modern slate border */\n    border-radius: 50% !important;\n    outline: none !important;\n    margin: 0 !important;\n    cursor: pointer !important;\n    background-color: #ffffff !important;\n    transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out !important;\n    position: relative !important;\n}\n\n/* Radio Hover State */\n.o_field_radio input[type=\"radio\"]:hover {\n    border-color: #0b3d91 !important;\n    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(11, 61, 145, 0.12) !important;\n}\n\n/* Radio Checked State (Brand Color Dot & Border) */\n.o_field_radio input[type=\"radio\"]:checked {\n    border-color: #0b3d91 !important;\n    background-color: #ffffff !important;\n    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(11, 61, 145, 0.18) !important;\n}\n\n.o_field_radio input[type=\"radio\"]:checked::after {\n    content: \"\" !important;\n    position: absolute !important;\n    top: 50% !important;\n    left: 50% !important;\n    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) !important;\n    width: 8px !important;\n    height: 8px !important;\n    border-radius: 50% !important;\n    background: #0b3d91 !important; /* Brand Primary Color */\n}\n\n/* Radio Label Text */\n.o_field_radio .form-check-label {\n    margin-left: 7px !important;\n    font-size: 13px !important;\n    font-weight: 500 !important;\n    color: #1e293b !important;\n    cursor: pointer !important;\n    user-select: none !important;\n}\n```\n\nShall I append this styling to [crm_hide_new.css](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/static/src/css/crm_hide_new.css)?"}

{"step_index":2709,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-21T12:37:17Z","content":"To make sure it applies **ONLY to this Job Position / Roles & Groups page** and never touches any other page in Odoo:\n\n---\n\n### Step 1: Add a unique class `crm-role-permissions-group` in XML\n\nIn [res_users_signature_views.xml](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/views/res_users_signature_views.xml), line 82:\n\n```xml\n                <group string=\"Permissions\" class=\"crm-role-permissions-group\">\n                    <field name=\"perm_lead_quote\" widget=\"radio\" options=\"{'horizontal': true}\"/>\n                    <field name=\"perm_equipment\" widget=\"radio\" options=\"{'horizontal': true}\"/>\n                    <field name=\"perm_contact\" widget=\"radio\" options=\"{'horizontal': true}\"/>\n                    <field name=\"perm_product\" widget=\"radio\" options=\"{'horizontal': true}\"/>\n                    <field name=\"perm_export\" widget=\"radio\" options=\"{'horizontal': true}\"/>\n                    <field name=\"perm_company\" widget=\"radio\" options=\"{'horizontal': true}\"/>\n                </group>\n```\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Add Scoped CSS in [crm_hide_new.css](file:///d:/CRM%20Github/addons/custom_crm_extended/static/src/css/crm_hide_new.css)\n\nBecause all selectors start with `.crm-role-permissions-group`, it is **100% strictly scoped to this group only**:\n\n```css\n/* Custom Radio Buttons: ONLY for Roles & Groups Permissions */\n.crm-role-permissions-group .o_field_radio {\n    display: inline-flex !important;\n    align-items: center !important;\n    flex-wrap: wrap !important;\n    gap: 16px !important;\n}\n\n.crm-role-permissions-group .o_field_radio .form-check {\n    display: inline-flex !important;\n    align-items: center !important;\n    margin-right: 18px !important;\n    margin-bottom: 2px !important;\n    cursor: pointer !important;\n}\n\n/* Custom Slate Border */\n.crm-role-permissions-group .o_field_radio input[type=\"radio\"] {\n    appearance: none !important;\n    -webkit-appearance: none !important;\n    width: 17px !important;\n    height: 17px !important;\n    border: 2px solid #94a3b8 !important;\n    border-radius: 50% !important;\n    outline: none !important;\n    margin: 0 !important;\n    cursor: pointer !important;\n    background-color: #ffffff !important;\n    transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out !important;\n    position: relative !important;\n}\n\n/* Hover State */\n.crm-role-permissions-group .o_field_radio input[type=\"radio\"]:hover {\n    border-color: #0b3d91 !important;\n    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(11, 61, 145, 0.12) !important;\n}\n\n/* Checked State with Brand Center Dot */\n.crm-role-permissions-group .o_field_radio input[type=\"radio\"]:checked {\n    border-color: #0b3d91 !important;\n    background-color: #ffffff !important;\n    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(11, 61, 145, 0.18) !important;\n}\n\n.crm-role-permissions-group .o_field_radio input[type=\"radio\"]:checked::after {\n    content: \"\" !important;\n    position: absolute !important;\n    top: 50% !important;\n    left: 50% !important;\n    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) !important;\n    width: 8px !important;\n    height: 8px !important;\n    border-radius: 50% !important;\n    background: #0b3d91 !important;\n}\n\n/* Label text */\n.crm-role-permissions-group .o_field_radio .form-check-label {\n    margin-left: 7px !important;\n    font-size: 13px !important;\n    font-weight: 500 !important;\n    color: #1e293b !important;\n    cursor: pointer !important;\n    user-select: none !important;\n}\n```\n\nShall I apply this scoped styling to both files?"}
